notes.title: 120 Yen Stories is now available!
notes.content:
[h3] 120 Yen Stories has been officially launched! [/h3]
Thanks to your support, the first [b]special price of 25% off[/b], the special offer lasts for one week ~

[h3]FAQ[/h3]

Q: What languages does the game support?
A: Currently only Simplified Chinese is supported, no other language versions are supported at this time. To get the best experience, [b]please make sure to run in Simplified Chinese[/b]. You can check if your system is in Simplified Chinese in "Windows Settings - Time & Language - Region & Language".

Q: How can I get more new news?
A: Follow us on [url=https://weibo.com/imoegames]Weibo[/url], or join the official QQ group: 831107672.

Q：How do I communicate if I have questions and want to give feedback?
A：Welcome to join our official QQ group 831107672, or directly contact iMoe Games official QQ: 2377502578.
